word_counts: guides only; never a pass/fail condition
schema: one owner per page; planned owner Rank Math; no hand-written duplicate
specificity_review: worked example, decision table, checklist or diagram description; evidence must be reviewed, not merely counted

sibling_overlap.normalization: visible main-content words, whitespace collapsed, Latin lowercased; exclude code/schema/navigation
sibling_overlap.metric: shared unique 5-grams / minimum(unique 5-grams of either page)
sibling_overlap.status: HYPOTHESIS: proposed editorial threshold for Maziyar; no measurement exists because no pages are written

claims: every factual claim has an explicit sources.csv claim_id with URL/status/title/access date and supporting evidence, or its sentence says نیاز به تایید مازیار
sample_gate: Maziyar approves the wave, then reviews one sample page before the remainder is written
